{{Top|leg}}
A '''microthruster''' was a type of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] manufactured by [[Corellia StarDrive]] around [[3999 BBY]]. They were found on the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship ''[[Marauder Starjacker]]''.

[[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] also produced the [[N2-f microthruster]], used on the prototype [[StarViper-class attack platform/Legends|''StarViper''-class attack platform]] ''[[Virago]]'', personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun's]] [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].
